meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会分析你的 NanoClaw fork 与上游的差异,把自定义修改整理成迁移指南;升级时先在干净工作区检出上游代码,再按指南重新应用你的修改,避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你要求升级到上游新版本、提取本地自定义修改,或按已有指南继续升级时,Claude 会启动迁移流程。

say.text: 帮我提取这个 fork 的自定义修改,生成迁移指南。
say.note: Claude 会扫描差异并写出指南。

say.text: 按迁移指南升级到上游最新版,保留我的改动。
say.note: Claude 会在干净工作区重放自定义。

say.text: 已有迁移指南,直接跳到升级阶段。
say.note: 若指南已存在,Claude 会跳过提取。

howto.what_en: Claude extracts user customizations from a NanoClaw fork into a markdown migration guide, then upgrades by checking out clean upstream and reapplying those customizations, eliminating merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to upgrade NanoClaw to a newer upstream, extract local customizations, or continue an existing migration guide.

say_en.text: Extract my customizations from this fork and generate a migration guide.
say_en.note: Claude scans diffs and writes the guide.

say_en.text: Upgrade to the latest upstream using the migration guide, keeping my changes.
say_en.note: Reapplies customizations in a clean worktree.

say_en.text: I already have a migration guide, skip to the upgrade phase.
say_en.note: Skips extraction if guide is present.
